summary: Frontend-only verification completed: full static regression suite passed (242/242), new isolated hero-video lifecycle unit tests passed in Node, and focused browser checks confirmed mobile language-switch hide/restore plus theme/resource diagnostics.

integration_issues.flow: Real touch interaction verification via automation
integration_issues.issue: Browser automation context reports navigator.maxTouchPoints=0 and does not support tap() without hasTouch context; true OS touch path (CDP/mobile hardware equivalent) could not be validated in this environment.

action_items: CDP touch-path validation completed in main-agent follow-up. Physical iOS Safari/Android Chrome video app-switch acceptance remains pending.
Resolved: duplicate aria-current attributes removed in the two flagged pages; original language semantics preserved and tested independently of attribute order.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero lifecycle manager behavior is now verified in isolation (max 3 attempts, pending-play guard, manual-pause persistence, reduced-motion gating, pagehide/pageshow handling, and bounded watchdog).
Focused browser diagnostics confirm Chromium codec limitation in this runner: canPlayType('video/mp4; codecs=avc1.640028') returns empty and fresh video readyState is 0 before load.
styles.css remains very large (>700 lines), which increases maintenance risk; consider modular CSS split in a dedicated refactor.
